title: Gabby and the dollhouse.
lines: Gabby is a girl with curly hair and a big smile.
She has a pink headband and two cat ears on her head.
And she loves crafts and surprises.
In her room there is a big dollhouse.
It's pink, with lots and lots of little rooms.
When Gabby puts on her ears and says the magic words, she gets very small.
And then she can walk around inside the dollhouse.
Today Gabby puts on her ears.
She puts her hands over her eyes.
And look, she gets smaller and smaller.
She's as small as a mouse.
And she's standing at the door of the dollhouse.
He's a soft toy panda, but with a cat's tail.
Because in the dollhouse all the animals are a little bit cat.
Today we're throwing a surprise party, says Gabby.
Kitty Fairy is a little kitten with butterfly wings.
She lives in the dollhouse garden.
First they go to the kitchen.
Cakey is a cupcake who can talk.
He's a bit of a crybaby, but he bakes the tastiest cakes.
Cakey, calls Gabby, can you bake a cake for Kitty Fairy?
They put flour in a bowl.
Then the cake goes into the oven.
Meanwhile Gabby and Pandy go to the craft room.
Baby Box is a cardboard box, with scissors and a glue stick.
Baby Box, says Gabby, we need streamers.
She makes paper streamers in all the colours of the rainbow.
And a big card in the shape of a butterfly.
Gabby writes on it: Happy birthday, Kitty Fairy!
Then they go to the bathroom.
MerCat lives there, a mermaid cat.
Can I make bubbles for the party?
A little box comes rolling along.
It always comes when something special happens.
Now they have to fetch Kitty Fairy.
Kitty Fairy is sitting among the flowers.
Everyone is so busy today, says Kitty Fairy.
I think they've forgotten my birthday.
I want to show you something.
They walk to the big room together.
Kitty Fairy stares with big eyes.
The streamers, the bubbles, the cake, all her friends.
Her little wings start to flutter with joy.
Cakey, Pandy, Baby Box, MerCat, Kitty Fairy and Gabby.
After the party it's time to go back.
Gabby waves to all her friends.
And she gets big again, in her own room.
There, in the big room, the streamers are still hanging.
